title: Catamaran, swim and tapas in Barcelona
text: An ideal experience for those who want to enjoy the sea and discover Barcelona from another perspective. The Swim & Tapas activity combines a catamaran ride, a stop for a swim and a moment to enjoy some tapas on board. It is a different plan to spend a few hours with friends or as a couple, especially when the weather is nice.
author: U3149YMvictoriac

title: A great gift!
text: I gave it to my partner, and it was the most beautiful way to speed up his birthday in a special way! The captain very friendly and told us a lot of things about the city. Totally recommended.
author: ragomez410

title: Great Day on the Water in Barcelona
text: Our Captian was great and was very attentive to our needs. He was also very knowledgeable and knew exactly where to take us to view the city and swim.
author: Carlos_L
